speaker: Priya
text: Morning everyone, give it a sec, Tom is still joining.

speaker: Marcus
text: Did anyone else get caught in that rain on Saturday? I was halfway up the trail when it started.

speaker: Lena
text: Ha, I stayed in and finally finished that puzzle. Two thousand pieces.

speaker: Tom
text: Sorry, sorry, the coffee machine on four is broken again so I had to go downstairs.

speaker: Priya
text: No worries. Okay, let's get into it. The goal today is to lock the plan for the search feature before the beta.

speaker: Priya
text: First question is the backend. Marcus, where did you land on Elasticsearch versus Postgres full-text search?

speaker: Marcus
text: I benchmarked both on last month's data. Postgres full-text is within twenty milliseconds of Elasticsearch for our volume, and it's one less service to run.

speaker: Tom
text: Half joking, but should we just rewrite the indexer in Rust while we're at it?

speaker: Marcus
text: Let's not. That's a whole quarter of work for no measurable gain.

speaker: Priya
text: Agreed, no rewrite. So, are we all comfortable going with Postgres full-text search for version one?

speaker: Lena
text: Yes from me.

speaker: Tom
text: Fine by me, it's easier to test.

speaker: Priya
text: Great, then that's decided: we use Postgres full-text search for v1 and revisit Elasticsearch only if we outgrow it.

speaker: Priya
text: Marcus, can you build the search API endpoint? I'd like it by Friday so Lena isn't blocked.

speaker: Marcus
text: Yeah, I'll have the search endpoint up by Friday.

speaker: Priya
text: Lena, the search results page.

speaker: Lena
text: I can do the results page. I'll aim to have it ready by the end of next week, since it depends on Marcus's endpoint.

speaker: Priya
text: Tom, we need a test plan for search, edge cases, empty queries, that kind of thing.

speaker: Tom
text: Sure, I'll write the search test plan. I'll get you a draft tomorrow.

speaker: Lena
text: Someone could maybe look at dark mode at some point, but that's not for now.

speaker: Priya
text: Right, parking that. Marcus, one more thing: the migration for the new search index columns.

speaker: Marcus
text: Sure, I'll write that migration too.

speaker: Priya
text: And I'll update the beta announcement email to mention search.

speaker: Tom
text: Do we know yet whether the beta users get search on day one, or behind a flag?

speaker: Priya
text: Good question, I don't know yet. I'll need to check with sales.

speaker: Lena
text: By the way, are we still doing the team lunch thing on Thursday?

speaker: Marcus
text: I hope so, I've been looking forward to that taco place.

speaker: Priya
text: Yes, Thursday lunch is on. Okay, I think that's everything. Thanks all.
